silence_control.scope: single synthetic silence warmup; not a full no-speech validation

protocol: mono16kHz; fixed30s; French/Arabic hint (Darija uses Arabic mode) where supported; greedy/beam1; no VAD; warmup1s silence; load/warmup excluded
comparison_normalization: NFKC/casefold; punctuation/symbols to spaces; Arabic diacritics/tatweel removed; accents and letters retained
